admissible_numerical_evidence_forms: source-supplied condition-indexed measured numerical observations with units
official machine-readable measurement arrays/tables linked to the primary protocol source
primary-source tables or appendices with explicit measurement-condition keys
source-processed measured values when the source clearly identifies processing and measured carrier
source-stated per-condition uncertainty/covariance/error model or explicitly scoped global uncertainty

forbidden_sources: R050 PR #541 candidate-specific matrices/bridge results/debt vectors/Pareto observations
classical pi numerical value as data selection signal
candidate_information_quarantine.mitigation: quarantine and never use incidental candidate-specific information for source, row, split, tolerance, residual, replacement or eligibility choices

allowed_rules_in_preference_order: source-defined independent calibration/construction versus validation/holdout subsets
cross-realization split when independent realizations exist
predeclared disjoint condition ranges based only on protocol condition keys
alternating condition IDs after stable source ordering
SHA256(condition_key_utf8) parity with construction=even and holdout=odd
construction_holdout_split_rule.default_when_no_source_defined_split: alternating condition IDs after stable source-native ordering, construction indices at zero-based even positions and holdout indices at zero-based odd positions
forbidden_split_signals: post-hoc movement of failed holdout conditions into construction
construction_holdout_split_rule.minimum_holdout_requirement: at least one construction observation and one disjoint holdout observation; if a fitted parameter is estimated from construction, holdout observations must not enter estimation

duplicate_and_training_source_collision_.collision_found_after_freeze: mark affected row/generation ineligible; do not mutate frozen target; create a new candidate-blind generation if needed

immutability.amendment_rule: Any change after this hash requires a new protocol generation and cannot retroactively govern data already selected under this generation.

inadmissible_evidence_forms_for_e4: synthetic observations generated by the researcher
numbers guessed or inferred from prose without condition-indexed measurements
manual visual plot digitization when no source-supplied numerical table/data file exists
classical formula/model curve treated as empirical observation
calculated/model-derived output presented as measured output
conditions selected after candidate predictions are known
same observation used both for parameter fitting and holdout scoring
classical pi numerical value used as a data/row/split selection signal
r049_target_hash_algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical compact JSON of sorted mapping {filename: exact-file-byte-sha256}; manifest itself excluded

replacement_requirements: real measured observations in machine-readable or source-tabulated form
measured output not merely calculated descendant
construction/holdout split freezeable before candidate access
candidate information not used in selection

target_hash_algorithm: For R051 target: compute SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 bytes for each authoritative target file excluding the manifest; build a mapping {basename: 'sha256:<hex>'}; serialize with UTF-8 JSON sort_keys=true, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=false; SHA-256 of those bytes is R051_QUANTITATIVE_TARGET_SHA256.

uncertainty_propagation_rule.authoritative_layer: source units and source uncertainty semantics
uncertainty_propagation_rule.pass_fail_rule: PASS/FAIL may use only an explicit source-stated tolerance/uncertainty/acceptance semantics. If none exists, retain quantitative data for E3 construction or descriptive residuals but do not invent an E4 PASS/FAIL threshold.
uncertainty_propagation_rule.rounding_policy: preserve displayed/source precision; never add digits; record table rounding/display precision separately
uncertainty_propagation_rule.unit_normalization: derived convenience copy only; original values authoritative; each conversion applied once and recorded in metrology ledger
